svg.title: Recognizing the bracketed dashed airspace boundary
svg.desc: An enlarged schematic sample emphasizes separated bracket-shaped dashes. The original user-annotated Toronto chart excerpt below shows the circled line near Billy Bishop. Read the boundary together with its class and altitude label.

g.text: The bracket-shaped dashes circled on your Toronto chart
Short dashed sections • small perpendicular end-strokes • clear gaps
Schematic enlargement; orientation follows the boundary on the chart.
Trace it to the associated airspace
Class C • surface to 2,500 ft ASL
as depicted in the supplied screenshot.
The pattern alone does not establish C.
Recognize the line • follow the boundary • confirm the label
Source: user-annotated FltPlan chart screenshot. Chart edition unknown. Study illustration only.
